items.text: Dream Team
Discover your gifts. Use them for God's glory.
The Dream Team is every volunteer who helps make church happen at Faith Christian Center. Whatever your gift, there is a place for you on the team.
Why we serve
We follow Jesus
Jesus came to serve. When we serve one another, we follow His example.
We reach people
Every team helps someone meet Jesus, find community and live with purpose.
We grow together
Serving side by side is one of the best ways to build real friendships and feel at home.
Find your team
Prays with people at the altar and stands with them in faith.
Runs sound, cameras and the livestream so every message reaches every screen.
Sets up, serves and hosts our church meals and special events.
Helps people find Bibles, books and resources to keep growing.
Serves coffee and good conversation before and after services.
Brings the message to life through stage and creative arts.
Plans and runs the gatherings that bring our church family together.
Teaches, loves and cares for our children every Sunday.
Greets every guest and helps first-time visitors feel at home.
Leads the church in worship through voice and instruments.
Captures the moments and stories of our church family.
Keeps God's house clean, ready and welcoming for everyone.
Helps people to their seats and keeps every service running smoothly.
Serves in worship through dance, flags and creative expression.
How to join
Choose the team that fits your gifts.
Fill out the form below.
A team leader will reach out to get you started.
Join the Dream Team
